{{nutritionsummary|1/4 of recipe (75 g)|4|121|1|0.16 g|0.035 g|3 mg|11 mg|29.1 g|0.85 g|22.6 g|0.685 g|0%|21%|1%|1%}}

==Ingredients==
*100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (3.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Blackberry|blackberries]]
*80 g (2.8 oz / ⅓ cup) white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
*240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (8.1 oz / 1 cup) water
*20 g (0.71 oz / ⅙ cup) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]

==Procedure==
#Put the fruit in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
#Add sugar, cornstarch, and water, and mash to a pulp.
#Simmer or boil, uncovered, to reduce moisture.
#Serve hot over [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]], or cold as [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* [[cookbook:Raspberry|Raspberries]], [[cookbook:plum|plum]]s, [[cookbook:blueberry|blueberries]], and [[cookbook:peach|peach]]es may be cooked in the same way.
